input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: Section 20(d) imposes a blanket consent requirement on assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out for Sparkling and no reasonableness standard, which is our walk-away position; it is reinforced by Section 3(c) (no assignment except as authorized by Garman in writing) and the "non-transferable" licence in Section 2. Nothing gives Garman a change-of-control termination right, but the absence of any change-of-control language leaves our reorganisations exposed to being treated as an assignment. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for us, keeps Garman's assignment subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and off-limits to our competitors, and confirms that a change of control of Sparkling is not an assignment and triggers no Garman termination or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling, qualify Garman's assignment rights, and confirm no change-of-control exit or re-pricing.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced the blanket mutual assignment bar so that we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent (including the licence), while Garman's assignment still needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may never be to our competitor. We have also confirmed that a change of control of Sparkling is not an assignment and gives Garman no termination or re-pricing right; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Notwithstanding Section 2 and Section 3(c), Sparkling may assign this Agreement, and the licence granted under it, without the consent of Garman, to an affiliate of Sparkling or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. Garman may not assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Sparkling (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of Sparkling. Any other assignment by either party requires the prior written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. No change of control of Sparkling shall constitute an assignment of this Agreement or entitle Garman to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement or the licence.
